About this Property

Single level, Midtown Bend rental with two bedrooms, one bathroom, a large fenced backyard and a basement for additional storage. Convenient location just a few short blocks from multiple restaurants, coffee shops, Juniper Park and Pilot Butte.

This home is full of charm and character. Real hardwood flooring runs throughout the living space and newer vinyl tile flooring in the kitchen and bathroom. The kitchen is equipped with beautiful butcher-block countertops, a brand newer refrigerator and ample amounts of cabinet space.

The bathroom is equipped with a basin sink vanity and shower/tub combo. Each bedroom features a walk-in closet and the same beautiful hardwood flooring as the living space. This home has forced air heat AND air conditioning. The utility room that leads to the backyard can serve as a mudroom and it also features washer/dryer hookups. The basement is accessed through the mudroom/laundry room.

The backyard is complete with a large double-gate for alley access, and enough space to park at least two vehicles.

Pets will be considered on a case-by-case basis. An additional deposit will be required for any approved pets.
